read_by: kerbfront opus (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium, checked): 1 clean views + metric elevation
notes: Spanish-revival stucco gate pier (u~0-2, to ~4.3 m) with a red tile cap. Lower stucco wall to the right with a terracotta tile coping that steps down from ~3.0 m at the pier to ~2.1 m near u 5.5. The coping is omitted because a level belt would misplace it. A hipped tile roof shows behind, and a plinth runs at ~0.45 m. Photo 2 shows a 'FORT MASON CENTER' arched sign, an NPS arrowhead emblem and a recessed doorway on the pier. These were not confirmed on this face in the grid, so they are omitted. No Equator Coffees storefront or seating is visible on this face.
